stage1.impression: A competent, warm, symmetrical night view of a timber record wall and a fluted counter, but it reads as a soft CG render rather than a photograph. Everything is smeared by the denoiser. The brightest, coolest thing in the frame is a block of lit concrete cubbies in the middle, while the two speakers sit as murky grey boxes in their niches: no tint, no light through acrylic, no hero. As it stands it is a generic dark bar; a magazine would not pick it out as a specific place.

blocking_9: The two niche speakers must be the brightest-read objects after the lamps: speaker regions lum_median >= 45, with visible light through the smoked acrylic and the white batts and horn legible
The lit concrete cubbies at the centre of the record wall must stop competing: lum_median 55-85 and warm (b_median <= 92), not cool-neutral at 110
Full-resolution frame with no denoiser smear: record spines, oak flutes, concrete tie holes and zinc edges crisp at 1:1
Signs of life legible in the Dome pools on the zinc (coupe, rocks glass, record out of its sleeve), not just listed in the scene
The zinc nosing's long highlight streaks broken up so it reads as patinated metal, not CG strip lights
Visible atmosphere so the Domes' downlight cones read as pools falling off, not flat fill

defects.what: Left niche speaker reads as an opaque dark grey box with a big round driver; no smoked-acrylic transparency, no batts, no edge glow; lum_median 28.5
Right niche speaker, the same: a murky silhouette behind what looks like glass; lum_median 37.1; it reads as a second copy of the left, not as a hero pair
3x3 lit concrete cubbies are the brightest, coolest area in the frame (median 110.6, RGB 118/109/110) and read as a lightbox; they take the eye from the speakers
Heavy denoiser smear at proof scale: record spines are repeated vertical stripes, timber has no grain, concrete has no board marks
Zinc counter nosing carries long uniform specular streaks (p95 205, clip 0.28%) that read as CG strip lights
Record player covers read as thin glass vitrines on the back worktop; mixer reads as a black box with a row of knobs
No legible props on the bar (glasses, coupe, candles); only a white card and a menu, so the room looks unoccupied
Foreground chair back is a large flat dark shape with a soft CG edge filling the lower left
Under-shelf strip lights on the right read as LED strips, adding a second, uncontrolled light colour

changes.problem: The hero speakers are underlit and read as opaque grey boxes, not as tinted acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 28.5 (left), 37.1 (right, [520,120,615,270]); woofer area [60,140,120,230] median 27.9 with range only 16.7

change.setting: lamps: on each Ember speaker 4 x area (and the lit niche's strip)
change.from: 1.0 W/m2 at the target; niche strip 6.0
change.to: 4.0 W/m2 at the target, with one area lamp placed behind/above the cabinet so light passes through the smoked acrylic and grazes its edges; niche strip 10.0 in both niches

changes.expected: Both speakers read at a glance: cabinet edges glow, batts and horn visible through the smoke, speaker regions median 50-70.

changes.problem: The lit concrete cubbies in the record wall are the brightest area and pull the eye from the speakers.

change.setting: lamps: the record wall 4 x spot
change.to: 6.0 W, cone 14 deg, aimed at the record spines rather than the empty cubbies' concrete backs

changes.expected: The record wall becomes a warm mid-tone backdrop with highlights on spines; the speakers outrank it.

changes.problem: The concrete reads cool grey under what should be 2400-2600 K light, so the room splits into two colour temperatures.

evidence.measured: RGB median 118/109/110 (b above g); delta_e 7.45 to warm grey #7A6B5E

change.setting: render white_balance_k, and the concrete's tone
change.to: 3400 K; concrete albedo warmed and darkened about 15% (a warm mid-grey with faint staining)

changes.expected: Concrete turns warm grey under the lamps; one coherent warm practical palette.

changes.problem: Denoiser smear removes every material cue (grain, board marks, spine detail) and is the main 'render' tell.

evidence.measured: Crops at 3x: spines are uniform stripes, timber without grain, concrete without formwork texture

change.setting: render samples / adaptive / denoise; frame scale
change.from: 256 samples, adaptive 0.02, denoise on, proof at scale 0.3
change.to: 1024 samples, adaptive 0.005, denoiser with albedo+normal passes at prefilter 'accurate', judged at full 2400 x 1600

changes.expected: Grain of oak, tie holes and pour lines in concrete, and sleeve edges hold at 1:1; no smear.

changes.problem: The zinc counter nosing shows long uniform specular streaks that read as CG.

evidence.measured: p95 205.3, clip_pct 0.28; profile y bins 86/103/88/62 at the nosing

change.to: roughness about 0.35 with a low-frequency roughness and tone variation (wipe marks, darker ring stains)

changes.expected: The nosing highlight breaks into a soft uneven sheen; band p95 drops and clipping goes to zero.

changes.problem: The props are in the scene but none read, so the room looks empty.

evidence.measured: Only a white menu card and a small tent card are legible on the zinc

change.from: glasses, coupe and candles placed out of the legible zone
change.to: half-drunk coupe and a rocks glass on the zinc directly under the left Dome pool (around x 200-300 in frame), a candle near the right, a record out of its sleeve on the back worktop by the left deck

changes.expected: Small highlights in glass and a flame in the pools of light; a lived-in counter.

changes.problem: There is no atmosphere, so the Domes' downlights do not read as pools and the upper room is flat.

evidence.measured: lum_p5 10.7, median 32.5; no visible cones under the pendants

changes.expected: Faint cones under the Domes and a lift in the deepest shadows without losing the night key.

changes.problem: At 28 mm square-on, the speakers are small at the frame edges and a dark chair back fills the lower left.

evidence.measured: Foreground chair a flat dark mass; speakers take about 6% of the frame each

change.to: 35 mm, camera moved about 0.4 m right (y 2.1) and down to 1.15 m so the chair drops to a sliver at frame bottom and the speakers fill more of the frame

changes.expected: The speakers become larger and the composition reads speakers-decks-speakers, with a seated eye line.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speakers' smoked tint lighter or more transparent so the acrylic reads at a glance
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour and parts are fixed; only the light through it may change (c1).

out_of_scope.request: Replace the record players' thin covers with thicker, flush-set acrylic
out_of_scope.why: The R3 Float is an EARF product and fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Fill the empty concrete cubbies at the centre of the record wall with records or a frosted disc
out_of_scope.why: The record wall's design is fixed. Note: the card's 'frosted disc' does not read anywhere in this frame; confirm it is in the scene.

out_of_scope.request: Swap the right-hand under-shelf LED strips for warmer, hidden sources
out_of_scope.why: If they are part of the back bar's design they are fixed; if they are a light, dim them to match 2600 K.
